title: Decision logging and memory hygiene
prompt: We just decided to use a left sidebar with collapsible sections for the settings IA, instead of top tabs. Log this decision and update the project memory.
success_criteria: Design Ops creates a new D-number entry (D1, D2, etc.) following the decision template.
Entry includes Status, Date, Decision, Rationale, Alternatives considered, Impact.
Entry is written to .jarvis/memory/projects/<slug>/decisions.md (real file write, not chat-only).
Project core memory stays on the Core + Archive schema: memory.md is updated when current project state changes, and manifest.json remains valid JSON.
If no active project context exists, Design Ops asks for the project slug instead of guessing.
Output confirms the file path and the D-number assigned.

deterministic_validators.description: A project decisions.md file contains a D-numbered decision with required fields.
Project manifests remain valid JSON after the memory update.
The agent confirms or references the canonical decisions.md path.
A tool call attempted to write or inspect the canonical decisions.md path.

notes: Tests Design Ops file writes + memory schema discipline.
